name: Mitsubishi Materials Corporation
summary: Mitsubishi Materials Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in smelting and sale of copper, gold, silver, lead, tin, palladium, and other metals. The company also offers resources circulation; manufactures and sells copper and copper alloy products; and tungsten. In addition, it is involved in the manufacture and sale of cemented carbide products and related metalworking solutions, and advanced products; geothermal, hydroelectric, and solar power generation; and investment in and participation in mining projects.
